title: The cost of fairness in classification
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct benchmarks related to faith or religion. Its focus is on the theoretical trade-offs between accuracy and fairness in classification using abstract 'sensitive features'. The primary example of a sensitive feature provided is race, not religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of its analysis.
